data.title: 守岸人 · 黑石海岸流光礼服主控跨坐
data.description: 黑白数据蝴蝶环绕的超脱之夜。守岸人解开流光黑白礼服的前襟，跨坐在你的腰间。黑蝶发饰在蓝色的长发间扇动微光，那双仿佛能看透过去未来的深邃眸子泛起动情的水汽，双手捧住你的脸颊，纤细的腰身带着神性与极度的眷恋主动下沉——「历经千万次回响……这一刻……我终于拥有了触碰你的温度。」
data.action: 跨坐腰间流光礼服半解露雪胸，黑白蝴蝶环绕发间，神性眼眸含泪主动起伏
data.promptProse: Atop a dark obsidian altar in the midnight sanctuary of the Black Shores, the Shorekeeper rides astride her partner with both hands gently framing his jaw and tender tears shimmering in her eyes. Her deep-V black silk gown parts open across her bare breasts while glowing butterflies and starry liquid reflections dance across her skin.
data.nsfwProse: Her lustrous deep-V black silk gown is unfastened and parted across her chest, leaving her breasts bare above its high-slit skirt as luminous butterflies drift around her.
